title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1992 N.C.R.B.- 39 2.3.2 A comparison of figures with the data of last two years revealed that Percentage Share of suicidal deaths due to ‘Failure in Examination’ and ‘Dispute over Property’ have increased, while that due to ‘Unemployment’ has decreased over the same period.
